description:
## Problem
On ClickHouse server at SF1 in a 5.25 GiB container, TPC-DS Q10 fails in every cell: `notuning`, tuned, and tuned with `optimize_after_load`. It fails in all three measured iterations and the warm-up with "Code: 241 ... memory limit exceeded ... maximum: 4.67 GiB". A query that always fails drops out of the geometric mean, so the TPC-DS keep decision silently excludes it. The ADR-3 addendum miscounts this as "three queries".

## Change
- Measure Q10's peak memory in each configuration (`system.query_log`).
- Decide whether the cause is the query transform or plan (for example, how the correlated `EXISTS` subqueries are rewritten) or a true memory floor at SF1.
- Outcome: either fix the transform so Q10 passes at the 5.25 GiB rung, or document a measured memory floor for TPC-DS SF1 on ClickHouse in the UAT memory-rung docs.

## Decision gate
- If the fix is a statement-level setting, check the owner's decision on per-query settings (`tuning-evidence-tuned-mode-promise-20261008`, D1) first. A fix needed for `notuning` to pass is a harness requirement, applied and recorded in all modes, not tuning.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Do not hide the failure: no skip lists, and no dropping Q10 from reports.
- The query text must stay within TPC-DS rules: only implementation-level changes, nothing for performance.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`. Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop 5ca12e6ca.
